title: Collision-free planning solve rate
caption: Solve rate across valid, nontrivial cases. Invalid starts/goals and cases already within the goal radius are excluded by policy.

title: Solved-path length by difficulty
caption: Mean Euclidean path length among solved cases only; this is not the LQR objective value.

title: Planner runtime by difficulty
caption: Mean measured wall-clock runtime per benchmark case, including all attempts.

title: Tree size by difficulty
caption: Mean number of nodes in the selected planning attempt.

title: Final goal distance by difficulty
caption: Mean distance from the selected terminal node to the goal. Lower values are better.

title: Generator share of accepted tree nodes
caption: Percentage of accepted nodes produced by generator proposals rather than the conditional safety fallback.

title: Paired testing solve-rate comparison
caption: Both planners are evaluated on identical held-out testing rows with matched sampling, limits, attempts, and collision checks.

title: Planner iterations by difficulty
caption: Mean number of iterations in the selected planning attempt.

title: Mean rejected proposals per benchmark case
caption: Safety and validity rejections are counted rather than hidden. Collision/boundary rejections include proposals rejected before tree insertion.

title: Planning effort across all attempts
caption: Mean attempts and cumulative iterations expended per benchmark case.

title: Generated candidates and accepted nodes
caption: Mean proposal volume and accepted tree growth across all attempts.

title: Paired testing runtime comparison
caption: Mean measured wall-clock runtime across the same held-out testing cases.

title: Paired path length when both planners solve
caption: Mean Euclidean path length restricted to testing cases solved by both planners.

title: Paired testing outcomes
caption: Counts of matched held-out cases categorized by which planner reached the goal.

title: Accepted tree-node source by data split
caption: Stacked percentages separate generator-produced nodes from the documented conditional safety fallback.

title: Observed planner failures by termination reason
caption: Counts include only real failed valid-nontrivial benchmark cases; no failure case is fabricated.

title: Testing runtime distribution
caption: Case-level runtime spread by difficulty; whiskers and outliers reveal expensive cases hidden by the mean.

title: Testing solved-path distribution
caption: Case-level Euclidean path lengths for solved testing cases only.

title: Testing planning-effort cumulative distribution
caption: Empirical cumulative distribution of total iterations across all attempts for each testing difficulty.

title: Paired testing path lengths
caption: Each point is one testing case solved by both planners; the diagonal denotes equal path length.

title: Paired testing runtimes
caption: Each point is one matched testing case. Logarithmic axes expose the full runtime range.

title: Overall solve rate with cluster-aware uncertainty
caption: Error bars are 2,000-replicate percentile intervals obtained by resampling whole environment clusters, the primary uncertainty analysis.
